Resolves #18626
Resolves #18668

The View owns the grid's selection model and the bodies carry none — configuration, instance, registration, lifecycle, and the selection policy that used to run inside the bodies' render. `grid.View#selectionModel_` defaults to the `RowModel` class (instantiated once, on the View, registered in `onConstructed` after `keys` and the bodies), `null` is a grid that selects nothing, and a config or instance is the explicit model; `grid.Container#viewConfig` is the consumer seam, `grid.view.selectionModel = X` the runtime write. `grid.Body` loses `selectionModel_`, its hooks, its `selectedRecordField` and its `selectedRows` / `selectedCells` readers; a body exposes no model (a throwing setter is the migration guard), and a row paints the View's projected selection without touching it. The View follows the store for the one selection concern it owns — a record's `selectedRecordField` — once per grid: flagged records are adopted through the model when the store binds or loads, a flag change reaches the model exactly once however many bodies render the record, under the row-selecting models (`RowModel` and the combined `CellRowModel` / `CellColumnRowModel`) through the one predicate the paint shares, `View#rowSelectionModel`. `View#createViewData` re-projects the bodies for the column-selecting models, `View#destroy` retires the model. `applyViewSelectionModel`, the locked bodies' `selectionModel: null` lines, `BaseModel.getActivePeers()` and its seven fan-out call sites are gone. The three grid examples, the email app, the two bigData controls, the two e2e specs and the two guides move to the View.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms on real `grid.Container` instances with locked start and end bodies and materialized row pools, running in the unit CI job — the spec carries no `NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI` guard since 479337210c; the owning tree `unit/grid` + `unit/selection` + `unit/table` + `unit/vdom/table` 126/126 at 30562ec41e; the full tier 3944/3944 at `8d607b944f`, the later heads change three View members, five selection-model config declarations and specs) → L3 required (cross-body row selection and keyboard selection through the View's default model — `e2e/grid/SelectionMultiBody`, `GridViewFocus`, `BigDataMultiBodyNL` — in CI's e2e job, and run locally at `8d607b944f`: `SelectionMultiBody` 2/2, `BigDataMultiBodyNL` 1/1, `TreeBigData` 5/5 green; `GridViewFocus:29` (pointer focus stamps `neo-focus-pointer` on bodyStart) red — and red 2/2 on pure `dev@5dc6b80fef` with everything stashed, so a pre-existing local red, not this diff; dev's own e2e-engine job at that head is red as well). Residual: none, Residual-Owner: none.

Design source: the maintainer's ruling on PR #18656 (2026-09-13) — the View is in charge of selection, grid bodies get no selection model at all — completing #12758 inside the multi-body epic #9486 (phase #9492), with @neo-gpt-emmy's ownership audit on #18626 (IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABUPLkhA, the exact-head replay IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABUPY1IQ) folded in: the readable Body alias, the render-time selection mutation, the per-body flag handling, the ColumnModel swap, the surviving model on destroy; her expanded probe (the combined row models, baseline `5dc6b80fef` against `8d607b944f`) and her evidence-precision catch (the inherited CI skip guard) folded in 479337210c. The first CI-admitted run of the arms then surfaced #18668 — the selection models' arrays were one object per class, dev-old — fixed in 30562ec41e (this PR resolves it too). Contract Ledger: on the ticket (nine rows, added 2026-09-13). Intake: a self-authored ticket, re-scoped today; the drift probe on the named files since creation was empty at `dev@5dc6b80fef`.

## Deltas from ticket
- Fix 3 tightened past the ticket text: no read-only Body accessor at all. `Row` reads `selectedRows` / `selectedCells` / the model from `gridContainer.view`; a body has no readable selection alias, only the throwing setter.
- The selection policy leaves the render delegates: `Body#onStoreRecordChange` no longer calls `selectRow` / `deselectRow` (three calls per flag change with three bodies), and `Row#createVdom` no longer pushes a flagged record into the live `selectedRows` array during a paint (which marked a pre-flagged record even under an explicit `null`). Both move to the View: `bindStore` (called from `onConstructed` and by `grid.Container#afterSetStore` on a store swap) listens to `load` and `recordChange` once, `onStoreLoad` adopts flagged records through the model's own `selectRow` (so the model's policy applies — under the default `singleSelect` the last flagged record wins, where the render used to mark them all), `onStoreRecordChange` follows one change with one call. `selectedRecordField` is the View's config now.
- One predicate for the row-selecting set: `View#rowSelectionModel` (the model when its `ntype` contains `row`, else `null`) feeds `selectedRows`, `onStoreLoad` and `onStoreRecordChange`. The second head gated the adoption on `ntype === 'selection-grid-rowmodel'` while the deleted render push had served every `ntype` containing `row`, so `CellRowModel` / `CellColumnRowModel` lost annotation-driven selection — gesture path included (`CellRowModel#onCellClick` → `updateAnnotations` → `recordChange` → the View). A declared row-selection trait on the model classes belongs to the hierarchy refactor #9075.
- #18668, found by this PR's CI: `selection.grid.BaseModel#selectedRows` / `#selectedColumns` and the table family's `selectedRowIds` / `selectedColumnCellIds` were non-reactive static-config arrays — one object per class (`core.Base#mergeConfig` spreads by reference), so every model of a class shared its selection and a destroyed grid's rows reappeared in the next grid's model. The five declarations take the `Neo.selection.Model#items_` / `grid.Body` descriptor (`clone: 'shallow'`, `cloneOnGet: 'none'`); same names, same in-place writes. The #18198 shape, closing the full invariant in one commit.
- `View#createViewData(silent, force)` fans to the bodies — `ColumnModel`, `CellColumnModel` and `CellColumnRowModel` call it on the View they register with, and a ColumnModel → null swap threw on dev.
- `View#destroy` retires the model and stops following the store; core.Base does not destroy config instances on its own, and the model outlived the grid on dev.
- The View registers the model it created from its own configs in `onConstructed`, not in `afterSetSelectionModel`: during the View's construct `keys` is not yet the finished KeyNavigation (`RowModel.register` pushes into `view.keys._keys`). A model set after construction still registers at once.
- `ViewLoadingReprojection.spec` builds a bare `grid.View` with no container; it now says `selectionModel: null` — the default `RowModel` would register against the container that does not exist there.
- Out of scope and untouched: `Neo.table.Body#selectionModel_` (`examples/tableStore` still writes `table.body.selectionModel`); the model class hierarchy (#9075); keyboard navigation across bodies (#9496).
